children: BNP Paribas and Goldman Sachs have acquired more than Rs 1,041 crore worth of shares in food delivery company Swiggy, through open-market transactions on September 4.

BNP Paribas Financial Markets bought 1.78 crore shares of Swiggy for Rs 491.99 crore, while Goldman Sachs Investments Mauritius I purchased 1.98 crore shares for Rs 549.01 crore. Together, the transactions represented a 1.36 percent stake in Swiggy.
The shares were purchased at Rs 276.10 apiece. Swiggy shares rose 2.53 percent to Rs 276.10 amid significant trading volumes following the transactions.
Ohana India Growth Fund buys additional 1.64% stake in Shankara Buildpro
Ohana India Growth Fund has acquired an additional 1.64 percent stake in Shankara Buildpro, a supplier of building and home-improvement products, for Rs 51.88 crore through two transactions.

CapitalK-owned Category III Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) Ohana India Growth Fund bought 2 lakh shares of Shankara Buildpro at Rs 1,296.99 per share and another 2 lakh shares at Rs 1,297 per share.
The fund held a 1.6 percent stake in Shankara Buildpro as of June 2026. The stock rose 0.73 percent to Rs 1,298.20 on the NSE amid heavy trading volumes.
Ace investor Vikas Khemani sells half his stake in Unified Data Tech Solutions

Vikas Vijaykumar Khemani, founder of Carnelian Asset Management & Advisors, sold 1.07 lakh shares from his personal holding in IT services company Unified Data Tech Solutions, representing a 0.53 percent stake, for Rs 4.17 crore at Rs 387.61 per share.
As of June 2026, Khemani held a 1.05 percent stake in Unified Data Tech Solutions.
TenCore Partners Master sells 1.41% stake in CARE Ratings
TenCore Partners Master sold 4.26 lakh shares, equivalent to a 1.41 percent stake, in CARE Ratings for Rs 73.57 crore at Rs 1,725 per share.
The sale was made out of TenCore Partners Master’s 1.56 percent stake in CARE Ratings as of June 2026.
Anchorage Capital offloads 0.85% stake in ESDS Software Solution

Anchorage Capital Fund’s Anchorage Capital Scheme I sold 10.03 lakh shares, representing a 0.85 percent stake, in ESDS Software Solution, an AI ecosystem provider, for Rs 76.01 crore at Rs 757.44 per share.
Anchorage Capital held a 1.13 percent stake in ESDS Software Solution before the company’s shares were listed on Friday.
ESDS Software Solution made a strong debut on Friday, soaring 108.75 percent to Rs 895.55 on the BSE, compared with its issue price of Rs 429.

title: BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs acquire Rs 1,041 crore worth of Swiggy shares; Vikas Khemani offloads half his stake in Unified Data Tech Solutions
